subject: Mobile Development
title: Government Surveillance on Mobile
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Government Surveillance on Mobile.

hook.text: Governments around the world use mobile phones to surveil citizens at scale.

buildup.text: Cell tower data reveals where every connected phone has been, minute by minute.

discovery.text: IMSI catchers — fake cell towers — trick phones into connecting and revealing their identity.

twist.text: Edward Snowden revealed the NSA collected phone metadata from millions of Americans daily.

climax.text: Mobile phones are the most powerful surveillance devices ever created — and we carry them.

punchline.text: Your phone is a tracking device you willingly carry.

quiz.question: What are IMSI catchers?
options: Fake cell towers that trick phones into connecting
